name: kadiatou kone
epitaph: kadiatou kone · 2026–2097 · niamey · rural clinic nurse
lessonsLeft: always keep at least one close friend through every busy decade. they will be there when you need them most.
listen to your body and stay active. physical activity keeps the mind and body strong for years to come.
when you experience loss, turn it into service. helping others can ease your own pain and make a lasting impact.
